content_direction.premise: Marta starts with a concrete newcomer problem, tells Lukas, then demonstrates the practical solution step by step.
content_direction.teaching: One useful German phrase or distinction per episode, taught through visible objects and actions.
content_direction.continuity: Exactly nine natural-speed five-second shots, never more than 45 seconds: problem, tell a friend, demonstrate each solution step and finish with a resolved problem. Warm natural reactions; no forced comic escalation.
content_direction.graphics: Clearly labelled illustrative appointment app beside the speaker. A real named app needs verified UI. No real booking, patient data, face cloning or voice cloning.
content_direction.credit_policy: Explicit owner instruction required for each new credit-funded production; previous sample permissions do not carry over.
content_direction.daily_improvement: Use research/series-improvement-rules.json and real available analytics. Record one small experiment and one previous weakness addressed; do not promise more views or invent measurements.

time_budget.accounting: provider reservation units, including hardware multipliers
